thesis.observe: BTC $82,779 (+1.1% 24h), ETH $2,448 (+2.1%), HYPE $80.09 (+2.6%). HL total OI $11.38B (z30 +2.03), HYPE OI z30 +2.89, SOL +2.19. thesis.infer: Price up, OI up and near-flat funding reads as new longs building without crowded carry. That diverges from a contracting stablecoin supply and a Restrictive Macro lens (30): a market climbing on leverage-light demand against a tightening backdrop. The hl-cycles frame itself disagrees with the weekly structure (HTF phase EXPANSION versus mild risk-off). Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read the risk as skewing hawkish.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds between the True Market Mean ($79.2K) and the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) edge into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close above $81.7K with OI still rising would soften the risk-off label, a daily close below it is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.2K could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K, about 10% below) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil falling below $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and BTC extend toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.6K, far overhead).
thesis.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Market intelligence only — a reasoned read of public data, not a recommendation to buy or sell anything.
